semester: 3rd semester (winter term start); 2nd semester (summer term start)

learning_outcomes.text: Students will learn the basic knowledge of electrical engineering for DC circuits and homogeneous, time-constant fields and circuits with sinusoidal time dependence.
They can apply it to typical practical problems and interpret the results.
Students will learn the application of methods and models for solving problems in electrical engineering.

syllabus_topics: Elementary electrical quantities (current, voltage, resistance, electrical power, electrical energy)
Calculation of homogeneous electric and magnetic fields, capacitances, inductances
Calculation of AC networks with phasors and complex numbers
Measuring instruments for electrical and non-electrical quantities
assessment_rules: To pass the module, students must successfully complete the module exam. The weighting for the final grade is based on ECTS credits.
bibliography: A list of suitable literature will be provided
Rolf Fischer und Hermann Linse: Elektrotechnik für Maschinenbauer, Springer-Verlag (e-book)
